text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing independent mission: "Birthday 
Celebration." Happy birthday, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... Bourbon-san. But if you 
stay with Rice, you'll be cursed with 
misfortune—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—*Beep.* Banned keyword 'misfortune' first 
detection. Two more detections will 
initiate the self-destruct countdown.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh... whaaat!? So that means... If Rice 
says she's unhappy, Bourbon-san will... 
explode!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—*Beep.* Banned keyword 'misfortune' 
detected again. One more detection and...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! N-Not again...! No... I really don't 
want Bourbon-san to explode!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san is... so fast, so strong, and 
Rice's biggest idol...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Because Rice loves you so much, 
Bourbon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What's wrong, Bourbon-san? Rice didn't 
say any forbidden words, right? So... 
why...?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The self-destruct countdown is currently 
halted. However...— In its place, my 'joy' 
has just exploded.
